info.title: Web2Agent & SEO/GEO Intelligence API
info.description: Convert any URL into clean LLM-ready Markdown, run instant SEO & AI-Readiness (GEO / llms.txt / JSON-LD) technical audits, and enrich B2B domains with technology stack fingerprinting and public contacts.

get.summary: Extract Clean LLM Markdown & Metadata from URL
get.description: Strips scripts, ads, and boilerplate HTML to return clean Markdown, word count, estimated LLM token count, and OpenGraph metadata.
Audits on-page SEO tags, heading hierarchy, image accessibility, security headers, JSON-LD structured data, and /llms.txt + AI crawler access.

get.summary: Detect Website Tech Stack & Public B2B Contacts
get.description: Fingerprints frontend frameworks, CMS, analytics, payment providers, CDN headers, public emails, and social links.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target company domain or webpage URL

get.summary: All-in-One Extraction, SEO/GEO Audit & Tech Stack Report
get.description: Returns the complete intelligence report combining clean Markdown, SEO/GEO audit, and B2B technology/contact enrichment in a single call.
